title: docs: build the Console with pnpm console:build, not the retired objectui pin scripts
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D5QXEJEkGv9hHj99t49Ab4t)_

Part of #26035 (slice 2: ungoverned docs).

## What changed

The retired pin flow (`pnpm objectui:build`, `.objectui-sha`, `scripts/build-console.sh`, the `os dev` stamp-vs-pin refusal) is replaced by the in-workspace flow in five files. Re-measured on main `39ca5878` with `git grep -nE "objectui:(build|refresh|bump|clean)|build-console\.sh|\.objectui-sha"` over the slice surface: 22 hits in 6 files before, 0 in the 5 edited files after.

| File | Change |
|:--|:--|
| `README.md` | "Hack on the framework" runs `pnpm console:build`; the paragraph says what it does (builds `ui/apps/console`, copies to `packages/console/dist`, nothing cloned or pinned, `pnpm build` builds the Console but does not copy it). Timing row re-measured (below). |
| `content/docs/getting-started/examples.mdx` | Callout names `pnpm console:build`. |
| `docs/screenshots/render-readme-demo.mjs` | Prerequisite comment names `pnpm console:build`. |
| `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md` | Cold-tree trap, one-tree-at-a-time trap (the `OBJECTUI_DEPS_BUILD_CMD` override is gone; the fix is `pnpm console:build --concurrency=2`), the `stale-console-bundle` counter, and the run record (the `objectuiPin` env field is dropped: the console builds from the `framework` SHA). Trap names unchanged, so `check:platform-checklist` vocabulary holds. |
| `docs/qa/studio-benchmark/SCENARIO.md` | The console row and the "record both SHAs" step: one SHA now, plus `pnpm console:build` before booting. |

## Verified, not recalled

- `pnpm console:build` = `turbo run build:dist --filter=@objectstack/console`; `@objectstack/console#build:dist` depends on `@object-ui/console#build` (`turbo.json`), and `packages/console/build-dist.sh` copies `ui/apps/console/dist` to `packages/console/dist`.
- Ran on a fresh worktree after `pnpm install` only: `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 pnpm console:build --concurrency=2` → 72 tasks, 0 cached, 12 m 16 s, exit 0, `✓ @objectstack/console dist ready (80724 KB) from ui/apps/console`. Re-run: 72/72 cached, ~1 s. These are the README row's numbers.

## Left alone, and why

- **ADR-0082 L198** is not edited. It sits in the "Where the line lives" list under the maintainer's 2026-08-07 decision, so it is part of a decision record, and `docs/adr/**` is governed surface: editing it would make this PR Tier H. The neighbouring L197 (`scripts/bump-objectui.sh`) is equally stale. Both belong with the governed slice.
- **README `pnpm build` row** (6 m 54 s, 72 tasks) predates the ui/ import; `pnpm build` now builds the ui tree too, so that row is likely low. Not re-measured here (out of this slice's prescription surface); flagged for whoever next refreshes the table.
- The pin-specific drift guard in `packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts` is slice 3.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 42 derived, 42 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, all exit 0 (`check:skill-examples` after building `@objectstack/client-react...`). No `docs:check-links` script exists on main. `skip-changeset`: repo-root docs, and `content/docs` ships only in the private `@objectstack/docs` app.
